scope: Conclusion and README interpretation revised; no numerical or trading-rule changes.
verified_findings: Automated order/accounting implementation works under the tested assumptions.
Rebalancing had lower full-window CAGR and Sharpe than holding the initial fund allocation.
Trend reduced drawdown while reducing growth relative to the rebalanced core.
project_decision: Keep execution/accounting automation and buy-and-hold reference; do not promote trend to the default policy on this evidence.
